message.content: {"reason": "The current 0.7576 score is limited because the DeepFM branch lacks an explicit coupon-conditional interaction mechanism and the blend/threshold is selected from a single OOF split, making it variance-prone. Historical successes on this UCI coupon task show that coupon-context interactions and calibrated threshold search are the highest-leverage directions, while further target-encoding expansion is risky given prior failed attempts. Therefore the refinements should touch the stateful feature transformer, the DeepFM architecture, and the OOF selection logic, while preserving the existing fold-safe pipeline and artifact contract.", "module": ["data_processing_and_feature_engineering", "model_design", "training_evaluation"], "plan": {"data_processing_and_feature_engineering": "WHAT: Extend FeatureEngineer to emit coupon-conditional centered features for trip/context numeric columns (time_num, expiration_num, distance_bucket, direction_same_num, habit_match, age_num, income_num, has_children_num), computed as value minus the per-coupon training mean. WHY: Coupon acceptance is strongly coupon-type-conditional, so centering context within each coupon forces the model to learn within-coupon variance rather than mixture means; this directly supports the new gating layer and is lower-risk than adding more target encoders. HOW: In fit(df, y=None), after computing existing numeric columns, normalize the coupon column and store self.coupon_means[key][coupon_value] plus a global fallback mean; transform(df) appends columns named cc__<col> using the stored map with fallback to global mean, and keeps all existing ordinal, frequency, one-hot, missingness, habit, interaction, and te__ columns byte-for-byte unchanged so feature_columns ordering remains deterministic and reindex alignment is preserved. INTERFACE: keep fit(self, df, y=None) and transform(df) signatures, ensure all learned coupon means live on the FE instance so pickling meta.pkl transfers them to fresh-process prediction, and do not refit FE in predict_pipeline.", "model_design": "WHAT: Add a coupon gating layer to FieldAwareDeepFM so the FM/deep embedding block is modulated by coupon type: gate = sigmoid(coupon_gate_emb(coupon_id)), applied multiplicatively to field_embs before the FM sum and deep concat. WHY: The current DeepFM has additive coupon embeddings only, so it cannot selectively amplify or suppress feature dimensions per coupon; this is the classical field-aware FM motivation and should strengthen the branch that the blend currently under-utilizes, while the new coupon-centered features make the gate easier to learn. HOW: Add self.coupon_gate = nn.Embedding(coupon_cardinality, n_fields * emb_dim) initialized near zero-biased sigmoid, compute coupon_id = x_cat[:, coupon_field_idx] inside forward, reshape gate logits to (batch, n_fields, emb_dim), multiply field_embs, then use the gated embeddings for FM and deep; if coupon_field_idx is None, skip gating for backward compatibility. INTERFACE: extend build_deepfm(..., coupon_field_idx=None) and persist coupon_field_idx plus gating metadata under meta['arch']; keep FieldAwareDeepFM.predict_proba and state_dict loading compatible so predict_pipeline can rebuild and load the same architecture without refitting.", "training_evaluation": "WHAT: Replace single-split OOF blend/threshold selection with a multi-seed OOF ensemble over seeds (42, 43, 44) using the same 5-fold StratifiedKFold contract, selecting (w, t) by the median accuracy across seed-specific OOF predictions rather than one split. WHY: A single OOF threshold is noisy and can inflate the local score by ~0.005 accuracy; median-of-seeds selection is a variance-reduction mechanism that keeps the accuracy metric and prediction semantics unchanged while better predicting held-out accuracy, and historical successes support calibrated logloss-based training with joint blend-weight/threshold search. HOW: Add run_oof_multi_seed(features_df, y_int, seeds=(42,43,44), n_splits=5, epochs=18, bag=1) that calls the existing run_oof per seed with random_state=seed+fi for tree zoo and seed+fi*10+b for DeepFM, stores oof_deep/oof_tree per seed, then search_blend_threshold_median iterates the same w/t grid and maximizes the median accuracy across seeds; keep final_fit unchanged except n_bag=2 and epochs=20, use stronger dropout only on gating parameters via ARCH, and still persist best_w/best_t into meta.pkl. INTERFACE: preserve run_oof, search_blend_threshold, final_fit, save_artifacts, load_artifacts, and predict_pipeline signatures where possible; add the multi-seed wrapper and median search helper, print the per-seed OOF accuracies and selected median score for reproducibility, and do not use any validation or test labels."}}
